> Do not disclose an unpatched vulnerability, credential, token, certificate, exploit, SOS content or student data here. Follow SECURITY.md for private reporting.

## Control gap

Describe the preventive/detective control at a safe level (for example dependency policy, session migration or log redaction).

## Assets and trust boundary

Which roles, data classes, endpoints or deployment boundary are in scope?

## Acceptance criteria

List observable outcomes and negative tests without providing exploit details.

## Rollout/compatibility

Migration, feature flag, session invalidation, operator action and rollback considerations.

## Verification

Tests, audit commands and sanitized evidence expected before closure.
